newsitem.title: USA: Ethan Allen sees Q1 EPS at $0.52 to $0.55.
newsitem.headline: Ethan Allen sees Q1 EPS at $0.52 to $0.55.

text.p: Ethan Allen Interiors Inc said it expects first quarter net income per share to be between $0.52 and $0.55, up significantly from the $0.31 per share it reported in last year's first quarter.
The company said the expected $0.52 to $0.55 per share exceeds analysts' expectations for the first quarter.

Ethan Allen cited continued sales improvement, higher manufacturing margins, stronger performance of dealer and company owned stores and better international business volume for the expected strong first quarter.
